arabic text: When the prisoners were released, upon arriving in Madina\nFizza cried out to Zainab,, Zainab Madina has arrived
english translation text: When the prisoners were released and reached Madina,\nFizza called out to Zainab: Zainab, Madina has arrived.

arabic text: Our journey has come to an end, oh lady off your horse descend,\nThe grave of mohammed has arrived
english translation text: Our journey has ended, O Lady; descend from your mount,\nfor the grave of Muhammad has arrived.

arabic text: The people of Madina will come, they will ask what went on\nWhere should I start where should i end
english translation text: The people of Madina will come and ask what happened;\nwhere shall I begin, and where shall I end?

arabic text: We left in sham hussains daughter, in karbala deprived water\nShe cried for hussain day and night
english translation text: We left Hussain's daughter in Shaam; in Karbala she was\ndeprived of water, and she cried for Hussain day and night.

arabic text: Abbas hands got cut off, hussains head got severed\nAsghers neck was full of blood
english translation text: Abbas's arms were severed, Hussain's head was cut away,\nand Asghar's throat was drenched in blood.

arabic text: Aale nabi ka kafela, jab qayd se chut kar chala,\nnazdeeq yasrab jab huwa\nFiza ne zainab se kaha, bibi madina agaya
english translation text: When the family of the Prophet was released from captivity\nand drew close to Yathrib,\nFizza said to Zainab: Lady, Madina has arrived.

arabic text: Ab khatm hai apna safar, ata hai ab mujhko nazar,\nwo saamne yasrab nazar, hazrat ka roza agay
english translation text: Our journey has now ended; I can see before me\nthe city of Yathrib and the Prophet's shrine.

arabic text: ahle madina aayenge, barbad humko payenge,\nbetab sab hojayenge, ho jayega mehshar bapa
english translation text: The people of Madina will come and find us ruined;\nthey will become restless, and a Day of Judgement will arise.

arabic text: abbas ab aajaiye, paani nahi ab chahiye\nhimmat hame de jayaiye roza nabi ka agaya
english translation text: Abbas, come to us now; we no longer ask for water.\nCome and give us courage—the Prophet's shrine has arrived.

arabic text: tarpa rahi hai aaj bhi, rulwa rahi hai aaj bhi,\nyaad aarahi hai aaj bhi, fizza ki zainab se sada
english translation text: Even today it torments us and makes us weep;\neven today we remember Fizza's call to Zainab.
